header.title: Eclogae propheticae: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Clement of Alexandria
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's tlg0555.tlg005.1st1K-grc1, from Open Greek and Latin's First1KGreek (CC BY-SA 4.0), one English line for each line of the original. Only some passages are translated so far: those that the Atlas of Ancient Myth, Magic in the Ancient Texts and the demons-and-angels study cite.
header.statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.
header.availability: CC BY-SA 4.0, as its source requires: credit Open Greek and Latin's First1KGreek and this AI translation, and share adaptations under the same licence.

notes.urn:cts:greekLit:tlg0555.tlg005.1st1K-gr: ‘Guardian angel’ renders τημελοῦχος ἄγγελος, a rare word for an angel who tends or cares.

nodes.text: Scripture says that infants who have been exposed are handed over to a guardian angel, by whom they are brought up and grow, ‘and they will be,’ it says, ‘like the faithful of a hundred years here.’
